title: MCPs enforcement state (v1)
description: Per-consumer choice of which MCP servers participate in the 3-layer render. Disabled server IDs are NOT included in the rendered `.mcp.json` or `.gemini/settings.json`, regardless of which layer (base, project, personal) defines them. Negative-list (opt-out): omitted IDs default to enforced. Lives at `<consumer>/.ai-playbook-state/mcps-enforce.json`. Written by `scripts/apply_config.py`, read by `scripts/mcp/render.py` + `scripts/mcp/validate.py`. Unknown IDs are tolerated.

schema.description: Schema identifier. Const for the v1 lifecycle.

disabled.description: MCP server canonical IDs (the `id:` field of the YAML entry) that MUST NOT be included in any rendered config. Order is not significant. Empty array = all servers enforced (default).

items.description: MCP server canonical ID matching the `id:` field in `mcp-servers*.yaml`. Lowercase kebab-case.

applied_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last apply_config write. Informational.

applied_by.description: Optional human/CI identifier of the operator who applied the bundle.
